In particular, it configures lower layers for SRB1 integrity protection and ciphering using the algorithms in securityConfigSMC. Security for SRB2 is activated only after SecurityModeComplete has been submitted/transmitted; therefore, SRB2 is not used with the newly activated AS security before the Security Mode Command procedure reaches that point.

Thus, the value is the numeric identity of the SRB being protected (e.g., SRB1 -> BEARER = 1, SRB2 -> BEARER = 2), not the logical-channel identity or DRB identity.

options.B: Maintain all established RBs and their associated entities.
options.C: Release radio resources for all established RBs except SRB0, including RLC and PDCP entities.
options.D: Suspend radio resources for all established RBs except SRB0 until configuration is complete.

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.3.4, Reception of the RRCSetup by the UE
results.evidence: {'specification': '3GPP TS 38.331', 'clause': '§5.3.7.3, Actions related to transmission of RRCReestablishmentRequest (clause numbering/title may vary slightly by release)', 'answer': 'The UE releases all established radio bearers, except SRB0, and then proceeds with the RRC setup procedure upon receipt of RRCSetup in response to its RRCReestablishmentRequest.', 'normative_text': 'Upon receiving RRCSetup in response to an RRCReestablishmentRequest, the UE shall release all radio bearers except SRB0 and perform the RRC setup procedure.'}

results.question: Under what condition should a UE include 'rlf-InfoAvailable' in the RRCSetupComplete message?

options.A: If the UE has experienced any radio link failure during its operation.
options.B: If the UE has radio link failure information stored, is capable of cross-RAT RLF reporting, and the RPLMN is in the stored plmn-IdentityList.
options.C: If the UE is configured for RLF reporting by the network in SIB2.
options.D: If the UE has an active RLF report and is in RRC_CONNECTED state.

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.3.4, Reception of the RRCSetup by the UE
results.evidence: 3GPP TS 38.331, clause 5.3.10.3 (RLF report), together with the RRCSetupComplete procedure in clause 5.3.3.4: the UE includes/sets rlf-InfoAvailable in RRCSetupComplete when it has a stored RLF report (RLF information) available.

results.question: What must the UE do with application layer measurement reports that were not yet transmitted when receiving RRCSetup in response to RRCResumeRequest?

options.A: Buffer them for transmission after the RRCSetupComplete is sent.
options.B: Forward them to the new cell via the RRCSetupComplete message.
options.C: Discard any application layer measurement reports which were not transmitted yet.
options.D: Include them in the VarMobilityHistoryReport for future use.

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.3.4, Reception of the RRCSetup by the UE
results.evidence: 3GPP TS 38.331, clause 5.3.3.4 (RRCSetup): when the UE receives RRCSetup in response to an RRCResumeRequest, it shall discard all application layer measurement reports that have not yet been transmitted.

results.question: According to Note 4 in Clause 5.2.2.3.2, under what condition may a UE in RRC_CONNECTED stop PDCCH monitoring during the SI window for a concerned SI message?

results.evidence: 3GPP TS 38.331, clause 5.2.2.3.2, Note 4: a UE in RRC_CONNECTED may stop monitoring PDCCH during the SI window for a concerned SI message once it has successfully received that concerned SI message.

results.question: According to TS 38.331 Clause 5.8.3.3, which of the following is a valid trigger for a UE to initiate the procedure to transmit a SidelinkUEInformationNR message?

options.A: To report to the network that a sidelink radio link failure has been declared
options.B: To request configuration of NR sidelink positioning reference signal resources
options.C: To report the UE's location information for sidelink operation
options.D: To indicate the UE's preferred bandwidth part for sidelink communication

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.8.3.3, Actions related to transmission of SidelinkUEInformationNR message
results.evidence: TS 38.331, clause 5.8.3.3, specifies that the UE shall initiate the procedure to transmit a SidelinkUEInformationNR message when upper layers request transmission of the SidelinkUEInformationNR message.

results.question: For NR sidelink L3 U2N relay communication transmission, what should the UE include in sl-QoS-InfoList?

options.A: QoS profile(s) of the sidelink QoS flow(s) of the associated destination configured by the upper layer
options.B: QoS profile(s) of all configured sidelink QoS flows regardless of destination
options.C: The default QoS profile for U2N relay communication
options.D: QoS profile(s) received from the peer UE in UECapabilityInformationSidelink

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.8.3.3, Actions related to transmission of SidelinkUEInformationNR message
results.evidence: 3GPP TS 38.331, clause 5.7.3 (Sidelink UE information procedure), together with the sl-QoS-InfoList IE definition in clause 6.3.2: for NR sidelink L3 U2N relay communication transmission, the UE includes in sl-QoS-InfoList the sidelink QoS information for the QoS flow(s) associated with the L3 U2N relay traffic for which sidelink transmission resources are requested/needed.

results.question: When a UE detects sidelink radio link failure for a specific destination, what action must it take regarding the sidelink-specific MAC entity?

options.A: Reconfigure the sidelink-specific MAC with default parameters
options.B: Suspend the sidelink-specific MAC operations
options.C: Reset the sidelink specific MAC of this destination
options.D: Report the MAC status to the network via Uu interface

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.8.9.3, Sidelink radio link failure related actions
results.evidence: 3GPP TS 38.331, clause 5.7.6 (Sidelink radio link failure), in the sidelink-RLF actions: upon detecting sidelink RLF for a specific destination, the UE shall release the sidelink-specific MAC entity associated with that destination.

results.question: Which of the following indications from lower layers would trigger sidelink radio link failure detection according to clause 5.8.9.3?

options.A: Indication from sidelink RLC that maximum number of retransmissions has been reached for a specific destination
options.B: Indication from PHY layer about poor sidelink channel quality
options.C: Indication from RRC layer about PC5-RRC connection timeout
options.D: Indication from NAS layer about authentication failure

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.8.9.3, Sidelink radio link failure related actions
results.evidence: 3GPP TS 38.331, clause 5.8.9.3 (Sidelink RLF detection): the relevant lower-layer indication is an out-of-sync indication for the sidelink radio link. After the configured number of consecutive out-of-sync indications (sl-RLF-Threshold), the UE starts the configured sidelink-RLF timer; sidelink RLF is declared if that timer expires without an in-sync indication stopping it. The clause also treats a lower-layer indication that the maximum number of RLC retransmissions has been reached as an RLF-detection condition where applicable.

results.question: Which of the following actions is performed by the UE for ALL MobilityFromNRCommand receptions, regardless of targetRAT-Type?

options.A: Consider inter-RAT mobility as initiated towards E-UTRA
options.B: Access the target cell according to target RAT specifications
options.C: Forward nas-SecurityParamFromNR to upper layers
options.D: Stop timer T390 for specific access categories only

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.4.3.3, Reception of the MobilityFromNRCommand by the UE
results.evidence: 3GPP TS 38.331, clause 5.3.5 (Mobility from NR / MobilityFromNRCommand procedure): upon reception of MobilityFromNRCommand, the UE leaves/releases its NR RRC connection and associated NR radio resources before proceeding with the target-RAT-specific mobility procedure. This source-NR release action is common; processing of targetRAT-MessageContainer and access details depend on targetRAT-Type.

results.question: According to TS 38.331 Clause 5.2.2.4.19, what must a UE do upon receiving a segment of SIB17 if it has stored at least one previous segment and detects that the value tag has changed since storing that previous segment?

options.A: Store the new segment and continue assembling with previous segments
options.B: Discard all stored segments before storing the new segment
options.C: Ignore the new segment and keep the previously stored segments
options.D: Immediately attempt to assemble SIB17-IEs with available segments

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.2.2.4.19, Actions upon reception of SIB17
results.evidence: TS 38.331, clause 5.2.2.4.19: the UE shall discard all stored segments of SIB17 if, upon receiving a SIB17 segment, it has stored at least one previous SIB17 segment and detects that the value tag has changed since storing that previous segment.

options.A: RRC IDLE

options.C: RRC CONNECTED
options.D: Any RRC state

results.evidence: 3GPP TS 38.331, clause 5.7.1 (ULInformationTransfer): an IAB-MT uses the ULInformationTransfer procedure to transfer F1-C related information when it is in RRC_CONNECTED state.

results.question: According to TS 38.331 Clause 5.5.2.3, when the network modifies an existing measId via measIdToAddModList, what is the UE's first action regarding the VarMeasConfig?

options.A: Add a new entry for this measId within the VarMeasConfig
options.B: Replace the existing entry with the value received for this measId
options.C: Remove the measurement reporting entry for this measId from the VarMeasReportList
options.D: Stop the periodical reporting timer for this measId

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.5.2.3, Measurement identity addition/modification
results.evidence: 3GPP TS 38.331, clause 5.5.2.3: upon receiving a measId in measIdToAddModList, if that measId already exists in VarMeasConfig, the UE shall first remove the entry with the same measId from VarMeasConfig before adding the new/modified measId entry.

results.question: When the reportType is set to reportCGI for an NR FR1 measurement object and useAutonomousGaps is included, what timer value does the UE set for T321?

options.A: 1 second

results.question: What must the network ensure before configuring a measId according to the measurement identity addition/modification procedure?
